017public class CarrierGroup {
018        
019        public static float TOP_SPEED_PERCENT = 10;
020        public static float REPLACEMENT_RATE_PERCENT = 50;
021        
022        public static float DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT = 40;
023        
024        public static float OFFICER_MULT = 1.5f;
025        public static boolean isOfficer(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
026                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
027                        ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
028                        if (ship == null) return false;
029                        if (ship.isFighter() && ship.getWing() != null && ship.getWing().getSourceShip() != null) {
030                                ship = ship.getWing().getSourceShip();
031                        }
032                        if (ship == null) return false;
033                        return !ship.getCaptain().isDefault();
034                } else {
035                        FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
036                        if (member == null) return false;
037                        return !member.getCaptain().isDefault();
038                }
039        }
040        public static class Level1 extends BaseSkillEffectDescription implements ShipSkillEffect, FleetTotalSource {
041                
042                public FleetTotalItem getFleetTotalItem() {
043                        return getFighterBaysTotal();
044                }
045                
046                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
047                        if (hasFighterBays(stats)) {
048                                float rateBonus = computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(stats, "cg_rep_rate", REPLACEMENT_RATE_PERCENT, ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS);
049                                if (isOfficer(stats)) rateBonus *= OFFICER_MULT;
050                                float timeMult = 1f / ((100f + rateBonus) / 100f);
051                                stats.getFighterRefitTimeMult().modifyMult(id, timeMult);
052                                
053//                              float speedBonus = computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(stats, "cg_top_speed", TOP_SPEED_PERCENT, ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS);
054//                              if (isOfficer(stats)) speedBonus *= OFFICER_MULT;
055//                              stats.getMaxSpeed().modifyPercent(id, speedBonus);
056                        }
057//                      else {
058//                              // may be needed to make refit screen show the right values when adding/removing Converted Hangar
059//                              // leaving this be for now
060//                              stats.getFighterRefitTimeMult().unmodifyMult(id);
061//                              stats.getMaxSpeed().unmodifyPercent(id);
062//                      }
063                }
064                
065                // NOTE: this is a copy-paste from Level2, which is what actually gets used to apply the bonus!
066                protected float getDamageReduction(FleetDataAPI data) {
067                        if (data == null) return DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT;
068                        String key = "carrier_group_damage_reduction";
069                        Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
070                        if (bonus != null) return bonus;
071                        
072                        float bays = getNumFighterBays(data);
073                        bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT, bays, FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD);
074                        
075                        data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
076                        return bonus;
077                }
078                
079                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
080                        stats.getFighterRefitTimeMult().unmodifyMult(id);
081                }
082                
083                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
084                        return null;
085                }
086                        
087                public void createCustomDescription(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, SkillSpecAPI skill, 
088                                                                                        TooltipMakerAPI info, float width) {
089                        init(stats, skill);
090                        
091                        FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(null);
092                        float rateBonus = computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(data, stats, "cg_rep_rate", REPLACEMENT_RATE_PERCENT, ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS);
093                        
094                        info.addPara("+%s faster fighter replacement rate (maximum: %s)", 0f, hc, hc,
095                                        "" + (int) rateBonus + "%",
096                                        "" + (int) REPLACEMENT_RATE_PERCENT + "%");
097                        
098//                      float speedBonus = computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(data, stats, "cg_top_speed", TOP_SPEED_PERCENT, ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS);
099//                      
100//                      info.addPara("+%s ship top speed (maximum: %s)", 0f, hc, hc,
101//                                      "" + (int) speedBonus + "%",
102//                                      "" + (int) TOP_SPEED_PERCENT + "%");
103                        
104                        float damReduction = getDamageReduction(data);
105                        info.addPara("-%s damage taken by ship's fighters (maximum: %s)", 0f, hc, hc,
106                                        "" + (int) damReduction + "%",
107                                        "" + (int) DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT + "%");                     
108                        
109                        addFighterBayThresholdInfo(info, data);
110                        info.addPara(indent + "Effect increased by %s for ships with officers, including flagship",
111                                        0f, tc, hc, 
112                                        "" + Misc.getRoundedValueMaxOneAfterDecimal(OFFICER_MULT) + Strings.X);
113                }
114                
115                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
116                        return ScopeDescription.ALL_CARRIERS;
117                }
118
119        }
120        
121        public static class Level2 extends BaseSkillEffectDescription implements ShipSkillEffect {
122                
123                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
124                        float damReduction = getDamageReduction(stats);
125                        if (isOfficer(stats)) damReduction *= OFFICER_MULT;
126                        
127                        stats.getHullDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f - (damReduction / 100f));
128                        stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f - (damReduction / 100f));
129                        stats.getShieldDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f - (damReduction / 100f));
130                        stats.getEmpDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f - (damReduction / 100f));
131                }
132                
133                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
134                        stats.getHullDamageTakenMult().unmodifyMult(id);
135                        stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().unmodifyMult(id);
136                        stats.getShieldDamageTakenMult().unmodifyMult(id);
137                        stats.getEmpDamageTakenMult().unmodifyMult(id);
138                }
139                
140                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
141                        return null;
142                }
143        
144                protected float getDamageReduction(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
145                        FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(stats);
146                        return getDamageReduction(data);
147                }
148                
149                protected float getDamageReduction(FleetDataAPI data) {
150                        if (data == null) return DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT;
151                        String key = "carrier_group_damage_reduction";
152                        Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
153                        if (bonus != null) return bonus;
154                        
155                        float bays = getNumFighterBays(data);
156                        bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT, bays, FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD);
157                        
158                        data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
159                        return bonus;
160                }
161                
162                public void createCustomDescription(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, SkillSpecAPI skill, 
163                                                                                        TooltipMakerAPI info, float width) {
164                        if (true) return;
165                        init(stats, skill);
166                        
167                        FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(null);
168                        float damReduction = getDamageReduction(data);
169                        info.addPara("-%s damage taken by fighters (maximum: %s)", 0f, hc, hc,
170                                        "" + (int) damReduction + "%",
171                                        "" + (int) DAMAGE_REDUCTION_PERCENT + "%");
172                        
173                        addFighterBayThresholdInfo(info, data);
174                        info.addPara(indent + "Effect increased by %s for ships with officers, including flagship",
175                                        0f, tc, hc, 
176                                        "" + Misc.getRoundedValueMaxOneAfterDecimal(OFFICER_MULT) + Strings.X);
177                        
178                        //info.addSpacer(5f);
179                }
180                
181                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
182                        return ScopeDescription.ALL_FIGHTERS;
183                }
184
185        }
